product_overview: The National Schemes & Benefits Portal helps Indian citizens discover government schemes, check eligibility, calculate loan benefits, locate nearby facilitation centers, track application progress, and submit scheme applications online. It provides a citizen-first experience for exploring benefits and navigating the application journey.
core_goals: Discover central and state government schemes by category and search criteria
Check which schemes a citizen is eligible for through a guided questionnaire
Calculate EMI, interest, and subsidy savings for loan-linked schemes
Find nearby CSC centers and partner bank branches using search and map-based browsing
Track the status and timeline of a submitted scheme application
Submit an online application for a government scheme

features.name: Homepage Hero and Navigation
features.description: The homepage presents featured government initiatives, quick shortcuts to key portal tools, and accessibility options for language selection.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Browse featured scheme highlights in the hero carousel -> Open a quick action to explore schemes -> Continue to the selected portal area
Navigate to / -> Browse featured scheme highlights in the hero carousel -> Open the eligibility check shortcut -> Start the scheme matching journey
Navigate to / -> Browse featured scheme highlights in the hero carousel -> Open the calculator shortcut -> Review loan benefit tools
Navigate to / -> Access the language selector -> Choose an available language -> Continue browsing the portal in the selected language

features.name: Scheme Discovery and Search
features.description: Citizens can browse schemes by category and search for programs that match their needs, then open a scheme for full details.
user_flows: Navigate to /schemes -> Enter a search term -> Review matching scheme cards -> Open a scheme card to see the scheme details
Navigate to /schemes -> Choose a category filter such as agriculture, business, education, or artisans -> Review the filtered results -> Open a scheme card to inspect the scheme details
Navigate to /schemes -> Refine results using available filters -> Review the updated scheme list -> Open a scheme card to learn more about eligibility and benefits

features.name: Scheme Details and Application Entry
features.description: The scheme detail page shows benefits, documents, and eligibility rules, and lets the user proceed into the application journey.
user_flows: Navigate to /schemes -> Open a scheme card -> Review benefits, documents, and eligibility rules -> Start the application journey from the scheme details page

features.name: Eligibility Wizard
features.description: Citizens complete a step-by-step questionnaire to discover schemes they may qualify for based on their profile.
user_flows: Navigate to /wizard -> Select age, category, state, and employment details -> Enter annual income -> Continue through the questionnaire -> View matched eligible schemes
Navigate to /wizard -> Provide profile details that do not meet a scheme's criteria -> Complete the questionnaire -> See that no schemes match the entered profile

features.name: Loan and Subsidy Calculator
features.description: Users can estimate EMI, interest, and subsidy savings for loan-based schemes by adjusting financial inputs.
user_flows: Navigate to /calculator -> Adjust the loan amount -> Adjust the repayment tenure -> Select an interest rate or scheme -> Observe the recalculated EMI, total interest, and subsidy savings
Navigate to /calculator -> Change the loan amount and tenure repeatedly -> Review how the repayment estimate updates -> Compare principal, interest, and government subsidy breakdown

features.name: Service Center Locator
features.description: Citizens can search for nearby CSC centers and partner banks, then inspect center details and map locations.
user_flows: Navigate to /locator -> Enter a PIN code or district -> Review nearby center results on the map and list -> Open a center card to view its details
Navigate to /locator -> Search by location -> Apply a partner type filter -> Review the narrowed center list -> Open a center card to check contact and address information

features.name: Application Tracking
features.description: Users can enter an application reference number or mobile number to see their application status and progress timeline.
user_flows: Navigate to /tracking -> Enter an application reference number or mobile number -> Submit the tracking request -> View the current status and verification timeline
Navigate to /tracking -> Enter an application reference number or mobile number -> Submit the tracking request -> Review the stage badges and any status remarks

features.name: Online Application Submission
features.description: Citizens can fill out a multi-step application form with personal, bank, and document details to submit a scheme application.
user_flows: Navigate to /apply -> Enter personal details -> Enter bank account information -> Provide required document proof -> Submit the application -> Receive a tracking reference number
Navigate to /apply -> Enter invalid or incomplete required details -> Attempt to continue the form -> See validation messages -> Correct the entered information -> Submit the application

routes.description: Homepage featuring Hero Carousel with quick actions, featured schemes, stats, and testimonials.
Schemes directory with search, category filtering, and scheme cards.
Detailed view of a specific government scheme with eligibility, documents, and application link.
Interactive eligibility questionnaire guiding citizens to matched government schemes.
EMI and subsidy benefit calculator for loan schemes.
Partner center and CSC locator with interactive map and search by pincode or district.
Application status tracking with timeline progression.
